sources.title: Schematron V2 Small | AI Models | Inference.net
sources.evidence: Exact model page lists InferenceNet as developer and 3B parameters. Its embedded page state identifies inference-net/schematron-v2-small with contextSize:128000 and capabilities tools:false, structuredOutputs:true, imageInput:false, reasoning:false. Visible context renders as 125K.

sources.title: Schematron V2: Frontier HTML-to-JSON extraction at a fraction of the cost
sources.evidence: April 16, 2026 announcement explicitly releases V2 Small and V2 Turbo that day. It says their weights remain closed-source and API-exclusive, while the earlier 3B and 8B remain open. It does not identify V2 Small architecture or active parameters.

sources.title: Schematron - Inference.net Documentation
sources.evidence: Defines the Schematron family as schema-guided HTML-to-JSON extraction models. V2 Small accepts extraction instructions through JSON Schema. Identifies legacy Schematron-8B calls as redirected to V2 Small; this does not make their checkpoints identical.

sources.title: Inference.net public model API
sources.evidence: Live HTTP 200 response for inference-net/schematron-v2-small returns context_length 128000, max_completion_tokens 4096, input_modalities [text], and output_modalities [text]. Retrieved with curl after Python/web fetches failed.

sources.title: Use Inference.net Models in Coding Agents
sources.evidence: Explicitly excludes inference-net/schematron-* extraction models from tool-call support. Describes the public model API fields.

sources.title: Best LLM for Data Extraction: Schematron Quality Metrics for HTML, Tables, and Noisy Pages
sources.evidence: June 16, 2026 comparison names V2 Small separately from V2 Turbo and both V1 sizes; describes reasoning/synthesis as outside the task-specific extraction model scope. No architecture or active-count disclosure.

sources.title: Hybrid-Attention models are the future for SLMs
sources.evidence: November 3, 2025 training research discusses an HTML-to-JSON project using Nemotron Nano v2 hybrid architecture, but never identifies Schematron V2 Small. It cannot establish this exact model architecture.

sources.title: How Inference.net trains Specialized Language Models that cut AI costs by up to 50x
sources.evidence: March 11, 2026 training research covers a specialized 9B Nemotron deployment and OSSAS-Nemotron-12B. It does not mention Schematron or identify V2 Small.

sources.title: inference-net/Schematron-3B model card
sources.evidence: The first-generation 3B card identifies Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and llama3.2 licensing. These are V1 disclosures and must not be transferred to V2 Small.

sources.title: Circulated V2 checkpoint identifier (inaccessible)
sources.evidence: A third-party listing pointed to this identifier. The page and Hugging Face model API returned HTTP 401, so no model card, configuration or tensor metadata could be verified. Its name alone does not establish architecture, licensing or open weights.

developer.note: Developer brand; page also spells it InferenceNet.

family.note: Normalized lowercase key for the explicitly named Schematron extraction-model family.

release_date.note: Dated first-party launch says both V2 models are available that day. September provider listings are later distribution dates.

open_weights.note: Explicit closed-weight release; accessible legacy checkpoints belong to V1. The inaccessible circulated V2 repository is not evidence of distributed weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification for closed-source, API-exclusive V2 weights; no open license is verified.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal total of 3B, not an exact checkpoint count.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active count in the exact-model page, launch or later comparison; do not equate the nominal total with active parameters.

architecture.note: Exact-model sources omit architecture. Reviewed later comparison and training research do not connect a disclosed architecture to V2 Small. V1 Llama and unrelated Nemotron disclosures cannot be transferred; no accessible V2 checkpoint was found to inspect.

context_window.note: Exact live API count and embedded product state agree; visible 125K is the page display, not a conflicting 125000-token limit.

reasoning.note: Exact product page capability state explicitly sets reasoning:false; this concerns the exposed reasoning feature.

tool_call.note: Exact product capability state and explicit Schematron exception agree.

description.value: Schema-guided HTML-to-JSON extraction model for complex schemas and long web pages.
description.note: Replaces unsupported general assistance and routine-automation positioning with the documented specialized task.

patch.description: Schema-guided HTML-to-JSON extraction model for complex schemas and long web pages.
patch.notes: 3B is the developer-reported nominal total. Active parameters and architecture are not disclosed for V2 Small in the reviewed exact-model sources. Public V1 checkpoints and the inaccessible circulated V2 Hugging Face identifier do not establish V2 architecture or licensing.

summary: Adds the verified nominal 3B total, Schematron family and proprietary classification, and corrects the generic description. Confirms April 16 release, closed weights, 128000-token context, text modalities and no reasoning/tool-call feature. Architecture and active parameters remain undisclosed; no checkpoint count is possible from accessible exact-model evidence.
